title: Active mechanism specification
status_note: SCHEMA ONLY at S0.5. Implementation is deferred to S3 by closed decision (TEEG_00 section 2).
row_meaning: one row per (layer, gtype, section_key, mechanism, parameter)
signature: for each fixed (layer, gtype): D_{l,g} maps Sigma_cls x Sigma_dom to (mech -> param -> real or callable)

fields.name: mechanism_mode
fields.note: a property of a SIMULATION, global and not per-cell, written into provenance.json

fields.name: section_key
fields.meaning: the (class, domain) pair this row applies to
fields.note: rule R6: dom(D) must be a subset of varsigma(nu) for every assignable nu. Invariant I-13c.

fields.name: value
fields.note: a real number, or the name of an entry in callable_registry

constraint_C15_2: mechanism_mode == 'passive' implies D_{l,g} is empty for all (layer, gtype)

callable_registry.name: ih_sigmoid_L5
callable_registry.applies_to_note: BOTH apical and basal dendrite, per its source
callable_registry.argument: x, path distance from the soma, in um
callable_registry.implemented_note: S0.5 pins the signature and the constants; the body is S3. Every constant carries source and provenance in the table and none is hard-coded in a function signature.

callable_registry.name: ca_hotspot
callable_registry.argument: x, path distance from the soma, in um
callable_registry.form: g(x) = g_base * M for x in [360, 600] um, else g_base
callable_registry.implemented_note: S0.5 pins the signature and the constants; the body is S3.
